english.title: Move / transport equine within Wales / into Wales from other part of UK without accompanying ID or smart card
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) moved or transported an equine in respect of which an ID had been issued, namely **(..SPECIFY EQUINE..), within Wales or into Wales from another part of the United Kingdom without being accompanied by that ID when it was not accompanied by a smart card issued in accordance with Article 25 of Commission Implementing Regulation 2015/262
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 14, 22 and 34 of the Equine Identification (Wales) Regulations 2019.

english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant moved or transported an equine in respect of which an ID had been issued, namely **(..SPECIFY EQUINE..), within Wales or into Wales from another part of the United Kingdom without being accompanied by that ID when it was not accompanied by a smart card issued in accordance with Article 25 of Commission Implementing Regulation 2015/262.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 monthsNote
On the 12th March 2015, the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' Court was removed - as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
